prompt: I want to start a new WinUI 3 desktop app called NoteTaker, right here in this empty folder. I don't have Visual Studio on this machine, only the .NET SDK, so it has to build from the command line. Please set up the starter project and make sure it builds.

reference.approach: Scaffold a WinUI 3 project named NoteTaker (UseWinUI=true with a Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK PackageReference) in the folder, then confirm `dotnet build` succeeds.

checks: winui-project (required): a .csproj under the folder evaluates to UseWinUI=true with a Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK PackageReference
named-notetaker: the project is named NoteTaker
builds (required): `dotnet build` of that project succeeds when the checker runs it
